name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-bilinfo
title: Bilinfo
description: Unofficial MCP server for Bilinfo: a car dealer's cars, ads, prices and leads.

environmentVariables.name: BILINFO_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: User name of the Bilinfo API account (Listing API).

environmentVariables.name: BILINFO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of the Bilinfo API account (Listing API).

environmentVariables.name: BILINFO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id registered with Bilinfo's authorization service (Car API, Leads API, Model Catalog).

environmentVariables.name: BILINFO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret that goes with the client id.

environmentVariables.name: BILINFO_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Subscription key of Bilinfo's API gateway (publicapi.bilinfo.net), when Bilinfo gives one.

environmentVariables.name: BILINFO_DEALER_ID
environmentVariables.description: GUID of the dealer; limits reads of vehicles and leads to that dealer, and is the dealer whose cars are created, changed and sold.

environmentVariables.name: BILINFO_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: production (default) or qa, Bilinfo's test environment.

environmentVariables.name: BILINFO_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable the tools that change something in Bilinfo.

environmentVariables.name: BILINFO_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log of tool calls. No answer from Bilinfo is written to it.
